desc: Ideation: reformulate as A+C=2B, count via self-convolution of indicator, contribution (Q[2B]-1)//2 per B
Implement full solution: input parsing, indicator array, convolution (numpy rfft preferred, pure-Python FFT fallback), rounding, summation, output; handle N<3
Cross-check against an O(N^2)/hash brute force on random small tests, edge cases (N<3, no triplets, min/max values), and verify the three samples' counts

Validate exactness/performance at N,M=1e6: FFT length ≤ 2^21 with coefficients ≤ 1e6 keeps double-precision roundoff far below 0.5, so rint is exact; O(M log M) time and O(M) memory meet constraints; big answers (~2.5e11) handled by Python ints
